legacy_system_wide_atomics_api.interpretation: R580 exposes enable/disable UVM ioctls and rejects the policy when scoped_atomics_supported is true. Both ioctl definitions, dispatch routes, handler names, and the policy helper are absent from the pinned R595.112.07 and R615.78.08 UVM source files. The removed field is not evidence about CUDA C++ atomic scopes or hardware correctness.
limitations: Static source comparison only; no proprietary libcuda call path was inspected.
No old-user-mode/new-kernel ABI compatibility or GV100 atomic execution was tested.
